body_text:
It's finally cooler here, so I walked along the river every evening.

On Saturday I found a jazz bar with eight seats. The bartender plays records from his own collection and writes the names on a chalkboard. I think about it constantly now.

memo.transcript: Hello from Tokyo. It's finally cooler here, so I walked along the river every evening this week. On Saturday I went to a tiny jazz bar with eight seats. The bartender played records from his own collection and wrote the names on a chalkboard. I think about it constantly now. Ivy, you would love it. Talk soon, everyone.
